Acquire Healthcare Pvt. Ltd. Thru. Its ... vs Ms. Anita Singh,
Commissioner, Food ... on 29 February, 2024 
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:19229
Court No. - 19
Case :- Contempt Application (Civil) No. - 3963 of 2023
Applicant :- Acquire Healthcare Pvt. Ltd. Thru. Its Director Amit Kumar Mishra 
Opposite Party :- Ms. Anita Singh, Commissioner, Food Safety And Drugs Administration, L
Counsel for Applicant :- Ravi Dubey,Anshuman Singh Rathore,Surya Bhan Singh
Hon'ble Shree Prakash Singh,J.
1.  Case called out.
2. None present for the petitioner, however, learned Standing Counsel for the State is present. 
3. It seems that by the efflux of time, this contempt petition has become infructuous. 
4. Accordingly, the contempt petition is dismissed as having become infructuous. 
5. Contempt notices, if any, are hereby discharged. 
6. If the petitioner feels that the cause of action still survives, he may move an application for recall of the order within eight weeks. 
7. Consigned to record.
